description: PLA category-level (L1/L2/L3) quadrant for a marketplace over ONE period, from the daily category quadrant fact: per-category requests, response rate (%), currency-converted spend and daily budget, budget-utilisation (%), plus the distinct campaign and merchant counts active in the category. Grouped by the category hierarchy (category_l1 / category_l2 / category_l3). category_level ('category_l1' | 'category_l2' | 'category_l3') selects the granularity of the quadrant rows and MUST be paired with the matching group-by level: filter category_level='category_l1' and request category_l1; 'category_l2' with category_l1+category_l2; 'category_l3' with all three. Only categories with >5000 requests over the period are returned. Called once per period; run current + baseline to compare.

response_rate.selector: CASE WHEN ROUND(AVG(q.response_percentage), 2) > 100 THEN 100 ELSE ROUND(AVG(q.response_percentage), 2) END
response_rate.description: Response rate (%) = non-zero responses / requests * 100 for this category, capped at 100.

spend.description: Ad spend for this category over the period, converted to the marketplace currency.

campaign_group_daily_budget.selector: CASE WHEN AVG(q.daily_budget) > AVG(q.cost) THEN ROUND(AVG(q.daily_budget), 2) ELSE ROUND(AVG(q.cost), 2) END
campaign_group_daily_budget.description: Daily budget attributed to this category (converted to marketplace currency), floored to spend when budget < spend.

budget_utilisation_perc.selector: CASE WHEN AVG(q.daily_budget) < AVG(q.cost) OR ROUND(AVG(q.budget_utilisation_perc), 2) > 100 THEN 100 ELSE ROUND(AVG(q.budget_utilisation_perc), 2) END

query.REPORTING: SELECT __ATTRIBUTES__, __METRICS__ FROM (SELECT qd.category_level, qd.category_l1, qd.category_l2, qd.category_l3, SUM(qd.requests) AS request_count, SUM(qd.responses) AS response_count, CASE WHEN SUM(qd.responses) > 0 THEN SUM(qd.responses) * 100.0 / SUM(qd.requests) ELSE 0 END AS response_percentage, SUM(qd.cost_usd * scc.conversion_factor) AS cost, SUM(qd.calculated_budget_usd * scc.conversion_factor) AS daily_budget, CASE WHEN SUM(qd.calculated_budget_usd) > 0 THEN SUM(qd.cost_usd) * 100.0 / SUM(qd.calculated_budget_usd) ELSE 0 END AS budget_utilisation_perc FROM reporting.os_product_ads_daily_category_quadrant_report_pla AS qd INNER JOIN reporting.agencies AS a ON a.marketplace_client_id = qd.marketplace_client_id AND a.agency_id = '__AGENCY_ID__' INNER JOIN reporting.static_currency_conversion AS scc ON scc.from_currency = 'USD' AND scc.to_currency = a.currency WHERE qd.date BETWEEN '__START_DATE_1__' AND '__END_DATE_1__' AND qd.category_l1 IS NOT NULL AND qd.category_l1 <> 'na' GROUP BY 1, 2, 3, 4 HAVING SUM(qd.requests) > 5000) AS q LEFT JOIN (SELECT CASE WHEN cr.category_l1 IS NULL OR cr.category_l1 = '' THEN 'na' ELSE cr.category_l1 END AS category_l1, CASE WHEN cr.category_l2 IS NULL OR cr.category_l2 = '' THEN 'na' ELSE cr.category_l2 END AS category_l2, CASE WHEN cr.category_l3 IS NULL OR cr.category_l3 = '' THEN 'na' ELSE cr.category_l3 END AS category_l3, cr.merchant_id, cr.marketing_campaign_id AS campaign_id, SUM(cr.cost) AS spend, SUM(cr.product_count) AS product_count FROM reporting.os_product_ads_campaign_category_report_pla AS cr CROSS JOIN reporting.agencies AS a2 WHERE a2.marketplace_client_id = cr.marketplace_client_id AND a2.agency_id = '__AGENCY_ID__' AND cr.date BETWEEN '__START_DATE_1__' AND '__END_DATE_1__' GROUP BY 1, 2, 3, 4, 5 HAVING SUM(cr.product_count) > 0 OR SUM(cr.cost) > 0) AS s ON LOWER(q.category_l1) = LOWER(s.category_l1) AND (q.category_l2 IS NULL OR q.category_l2 = 'na' OR LOWER(q.category_l2) = LOWER(s.category_l2)) AND (q.category_l3 IS NULL OR q.category_l3 = 'na' OR LOWER(q.category_l3) = LOWER(s.category_l3)) WHERE q.category_l1 IS NOT NULL AND __FILTER__ GROUP BY __ATTRIBUTES_GROUP_BY__ ORDER BY __ATTRIBUTES_ORDER_BY__ LIMIT __LIMIT__ OFFSET __OFFSET__;
